aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: One kind gesture created a ripple in water across the team.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: An effect spreading from a small starting point; a water image.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: Why are some activities more popular than others?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Spreading from a small beginning to affect others, through an explicit water-wave comparison.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: an action/feeling spreads like a ripple in water; like marks the comparison; specify what spreads and the observed response
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Source mixes “created a ripple in water” with “across the team”; owner teaches the natural explicit “like a ripple in water” simile. A regex extension would certify awkward carrier wording.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Keep held; do not extend detector. Prior focused owner verdict reached same conclusion.

aliasCandidateFindings.expression: paint it in black and white
aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: We should not paint it in black and white when both plans have merits.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: Present a complex matter as two simple opposites; a fixed colour metaphor.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: Do men and women watch the same kind of films?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Clear-cut, with simple opposed categories and little ambiguity; often negated to acknowledge complexity.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: be/not be black and white; a black-and-white issue/decision uses hyphens before a noun. Both forms describe simple opposed categories in judgement, not monochrome images or in black and white meaning in writing.
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Binary-judgement meaning overlaps, and regex hits embedded “black and white,” but “paint it in black and white” is an awkward carrier not taught by owner; regex match alone is not a valid alias.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Keep held for idiomaticity correction; no owner change.

aliasCandidateFindings.expression: all fireworks and not much substance
aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: The speech was all fireworks and not much substance.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: Exciting in appearance but shallow in content; fireworks is a figurative spectacle.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: Do different age groups like the same kind of films?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Impressive presentation or publicity outweighs genuine practical value.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: More show than substance; compare visible display with what the event or proposal actually delivers.
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Fireworks-versus-substance judgment overlaps, but “all fireworks and not much substance” is a bespoke surface image; owner teaches the established “more show than substance.”
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Require naturalness evidence for source form and one assessed spectacle variant before any alias.

aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: The school should keep that door wide open for beginners.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: Preserve access to an opportunity; a door metaphor.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: Do you think it is necessary for the government to require all children to learn music?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerTitle: open the door / the door is opening wider
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Create an opportunity for something to happen or develop; an opening door can describe access increasing.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: open a/the door to an opportunity; open the academic door metaphorically names access to formal study. Open, opens, opened and opening are normal forms.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerTargetPattern: (?:\b(?:open|opens|opened|opening) (?:the|a) door(?:s)?\b|\bthe door (?:is|was) opening wider\b)|(?:\b(?:open|opens|opened|opening) the academic door\b)
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Source preserves a single already-open access route; owner chiefly creates/expands an opportunity. The action and verb construction differ.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: If editor accepts same owner, add bounded keep + demonstrative + door wide open branch, teach preserving access versus opening access, and assess one preservation case.

aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: Community performances help keep their roots alive.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: Maintain a connection with cultural origins; a plant metaphor.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: In your country, do people prefer to listen to traditional music or foreign music?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Stay connected to origins or defining traditions over time, including while changing or growing.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: Keep + possessive + roots, optionally followed by alive; roots is figurative. Name the actual origin, practice or people preserved. A new format can make the contrast visible, but change is not required for keeping roots alive.
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Exact cultural-origins meaning and current detector match, but owner 4470 is later than this source and current alias contract requires an earlier owner occurrence.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Resolve source-order ownership without changing established IDs; then add exact provenance. Do not reclassify under current rule.

aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: There is something electric about a small live concert.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: An exciting quality that feels energetic; electricity is figurative.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: Do you prefer live performances?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: The intense shared excitement or charged feeling of a particular event as it happens.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: feel/capture/miss the electricity of the moment; electricity is an excitement image, not a report about electrical supply. Identify whose impression and what moment.
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: An electric quality of an entire concert need not be the intense electricity of one moment; adjective and noun construction differ.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Require owner-scope and idiomaticity review; teach/assess general live-event quality separately if merged.

aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: The annual meal keeps family ties alive.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: Continuing connections among relatives; ties and life are figurative.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: What are the main reasons why people organise family parties in your country?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Maintain affection or emotional closeness in personal relationships, including family ties.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: keep relationships/family ties warm, with or without their before relationships; keeping and kept mark ongoing or past care. Warm refers to emotional closeness.
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: “Keep family ties alive” establishes ongoing connection; owner “keep family ties warm” specifically adds affection and closeness, not guaranteed by annual-meal sentence.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Keep held unless fuller source context supports warmth; then add bounded alive variant and assess continuity versus closeness.

aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: Why do some people think that national celebrations are a waste of government money? Do you agree or disagree with this view? Why?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Impressive presentation or publicity outweighs genuine practical value.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: More show than substance; compare visible display with what the event or proposal actually delivers.
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Surface-versus-value judgment overlaps, but the glitter phrase is a different image not in owner target/assessment; cannot alias merely by paraphrase.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Review conventionality of all glitter and no substance alongside 2349; if valid, add bounded form and one assessed contrast.

aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: Goals can change as life unfolds.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: As events develop over time; a fabric metaphor.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: How do most people plan their futures in their education and careers?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Develop gradually without great publicity or a dramatic moment.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: a story / process / talent unfolds quietly
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: “As life unfolds” says events develop with time; owner “unfolds quietly” requires low-drama, low-publicity development, which the source does not establish.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Keep held; do not strip quietly from the existing owner.

aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: Parents cannot always hold their hand on the journey to school.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: Guide someone closely; a fixed hand idiom.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: Do you think students should be taken to school by their parents or go by themselves?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Offer reassuring companionship or close guidance through a difficult experience; a negative form can stress that this constant help will not always be available.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: hold someone’s hand through a difficulty; hold your hand every step of the way stresses constant guidance, often negated to encourage independent action. This is figurative when no actual hand is being held.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerTargetPattern: (?:\bfriends\s+can\s+hold\s+your\s+hand\b)|(?:\b(?:hold|holds|held|holding) your hand every step of the way\b)
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: School-journey sentence can mean literal parent-child hand-holding for road safety; owner teaches figurative reassurance/guidance. Independent exact-source review already rejected this merge.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Keep held; no detector edit, as broad hold their hand would accept literal reading.

aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: Good players look ahead before moving.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: Consider future moves or consequences; a natural phrasal verb.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: What kind of puzzles improve people's intelligence?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Consider likely next consequences or needs before acting.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: think a few steps ahead before + action; thought for past; steps represent stages, not necessarily literal footsteps.
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Look ahead before a move in a puzzle may be literal gaze or future-move planning; owner specifies considering later consequences a few steps ahead.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Require source-context confirmation of mental planning; if clear, bounded look ahead form plus assessed consequence case.

aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: Which age group plays puzzles the most?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Remain essentially the same while appearing in a different form.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: An abstract quality or habit has simply changed clothes or changes/changed its clothes: identify what persists and what outward form changes. The clothing is figurative.
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Exact source sentence repeats source 3031 already classified to owner 1706; owner meaning and full-source detector already cover it.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Append exact 3998 source occurrence/provenance if absent; change only its provisional decision to alias-existing after independent hash review. No teaching or regex edit.

aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: At first, I felt like I was stumbling around in the dark.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: Proceeding with little knowledge or confidence; a darkness metaphor.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: Is it hard for students to learn new skills?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Try to understand, answer or proceed without enough information, examples or guidance.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: Grope, guess or work in the dark can describe proceeding without needed information or guidance. Work in the dark stresses continuing a task despite the gap; guessing stresses an attempted answer without evidence. Specify what information is missing rather than implying the person lacks ability.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerTargetPattern: \bgrop(?:e|es|ed|ing) in the dark\b|\bguess(?:es|ed|ing)? in the dark\b|\b(?:work|works|worked|working) in the dark\b
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Stumbling in the dark can mean lacking guidance, but source also glosses low confidence; owner 1916 teaches lack of information/examples. Motion metaphor differs from grope/guess/work forms.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Confirm insufficient-information sense in full source; then add bounded stumble around in the dark form and an assessed case distinguishing uncertainty from inability.

aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: During a dull lecture, the mind can switch off.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: Stop paying attention or thinking actively; a figurative phrasal verb.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: Can technology help people remember things better? How?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Stop paying attention or engaging almost immediately.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: listeners / students switch off straight away when + reason
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Source mind switch off in a dull lecture lacks owner 1487’s immediate “straight away” onset. Owner 375 is relaxation, a different sense.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: If retained in 1487, broaden brief and at least one assessment to delayed attention loss; bound subject/context so relaxation/device senses stay out.

aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: A good mentor is a bit like a compass.

aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: A mentor can act like a compass or be a bit like a compass; both compare guidance to orientation. Name the questions or principles that guide the person rather than imply the mentor chooses for them.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerTargetPattern: \b(?:act(?:s|ed|ing)? like|(?:is|are|was|were) a bit like) a compass\b
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Exact source sentence repeats 3350 already classified to owner 1913; owner “be a bit like a compass” pattern and guidance meaning fully cover it.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Append exact 4234 occurrence/provenance if absent; change only its provisional decision after independent hash review. No teaching or regex edit.

aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: Ethical rules must keep pace with human invention.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: Develop as quickly as new technology; a fixed movement idiom.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: What's the influence of science on human life?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Maintain or increase provision sufficiently to match the level or growth of need.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: a service/team can or cannot keep pace with demand; kept/keeping. Compare what is needed with what can be provided, not speed alone.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerTargetPattern: \bkeep(?:s|ing)? pace with demand\b|\bkept pace with demand\b
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Keep pace with invention is the same rate-matching idiom as keep pace with demand, but owner currently restricts assessment to provision-versus-need. Source gives a clear complementary change-rate case.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Extend detector only to keep pace with human invention or a reviewed bounded complement family; broaden brief from demand to matching a relevant rate of change; add one keyed ethics/technology assessment and aligned Chinese, plus provenance.

aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: Repeated cancellations can wear a relationship thin.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: Gradually weaken a relationship; a fabric metaphor.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: In what situations do you think people need to, or should, apologise?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Become gradually weaker or less convincing, enjoyable or effective through repetition or continued demands.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: the excitement can wear thin; wore thin / has worn thin; a feeling, explanation or patience may wear thin, with the subject specifying what weakens.
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Owner intransitive wear thin describes patience/excitement/explanations weakening; source causative wear a relationship thin is unusual and not currently taught.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Confirm natural causative grammar independently; only then add bounded object form and assess relationship weakening without false positive literal fabric.

aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: Visitors seek products rooted in the place.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: Strongly connected to a location; a fixed plant metaphor.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: In your opinion, why do traditional products attract tourists?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Seem connected to a particular history, place or identity instead of anonymous and interchangeable.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: a room / design / account can feel rooted rather than generic; explain what it is rooted in through context. The rooted image can also describe an account grounded in particular personal experiences, rather than interchangeable self-description.
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Products rooted in a place and owner locally rooted rather than generic express the same connection to local identity; owner brief already permits a place and design, but target/assessment are narrower.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Add bounded rooted in the place construction, teach attributive product form versus feel rooted, and key one local-product assessment with aligned Chinese; attach source provenance.

aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: Grandparents can pass it on to their children.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: Transfer a tradition or item to others; a natural phrasal verb.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: Do you think there are benefits of traditional products to locals?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Transmit knowledge, beliefs, experience, customs or remembered stories to other people, often by teaching, telling or showing them.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: Pass knowledge on to a new class or pass on knowledge; pass on values, experience and tradition, or stories to someone. Pass those stories on is the separable order. Passed/passing are natural forms. Transmission does not prove uptake.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerTargetPattern: \bpass(?:es|ed|ing)? on (?:our |their |his |her |the )?(?:values|experience and tradition|stories)\b|\bpass(?:es|ed|ing)? (?:our |their |his |her |the )?(?:values|experience and tradition) on\b|\bpass(?:es|ed|ing)? (?:those |the )stories on\b|\bpass(?:es|ed|ing)? (?:knowledge on|on knowledge)\b
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Pass it on could be transmission of tradition, item or product; source has no explicit antecedent for it, while owner specifically passes values/stories/knowledge.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Resolve “it” against complete source context before any alias. If it is a tradition, add bounded pronoun form and assess antecedent resolution.

aliasCandidateFindings.expression: transport has had to keep pace
aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: As cities grow, transport has had to keep pace.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: Transport has needed to adapt as fast as life changes; a fixed motion idiom.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: Have the types of transport people use changed much over the last few decades?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Maintain or increase provision sufficiently to match the level or growth of need.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: a service/team can or cannot keep pace with demand; kept/keeping. Compare what is needed with what can be provided, not speed alone.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerTargetPattern: \bkeep(?:s|ing)? pace with demand\b|\bkept pace with demand\b
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Source uses complementless keep pace with urban growth recoverable from a prior clause; owner currently requires with demand, and bare detector would admit unrelated senses.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: After 4289 owner broadening, consider a tightly contextualized elliptical branch and an assessed transport-growth case; otherwise keep held.

aliasCandidateFindings.expression: ripples have spread much more widely
aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: From one trial, the ripples have spread much more widely.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: Secondary effects have extended far beyond the original action; a water metaphor.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: What are the impacts of Uber on transportation in your country?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Spread from an initial event or group to affect others; news can also ripple through a city as people relay it.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: Effects, benefits, problems or reported news can ripple out/outward or through a connected family or city; a decision can send ripples far beyond its starting group. Name the initial cause and the relay link; matching timing alone does not prove impact.
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Noun ripples have spread widely expresses secondary effects, but owner 772 teaches ripple as verb and 924 teaches a ripple effect noun. Ownership and grammatical form are not settled.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Compare owner 924 before modifying 772; require bounded noun-spread construction and causality assessment, not a generic ripples regex.

aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: A city cannot live on reputation forever.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: Rely indefinitely on past fame; a fixed sustenance metaphor.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: What can you say about the future of the tourism industry in your country?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Depend on an established reputation for continuing support, rather than demonstrate the current work on which that support could also be based.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: cannot/should not live on reputation alone; a publication, organisation or person can be the subject. Alone limits the basis of support rather than denying that reputation has any value.
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Cannot live on reputation forever questions indefinite reliance; owner live on reputation alone warns against exclusive reliance. Source does not explicitly state exclusivity.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Review full source for present-value contrast; only then add temporal negative form and assess forever versus alone without treating them as interchangeable.

aliasCandidateFindings.exactSourceSentence: Hotels must evolve with the times.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceMeaning: Adapt to changing conditions; a fixed expression.
aliasCandidateFindings.sourceQuestion: What can you say about the future of the tourism industry in your country?
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerMeaning: Adapt one’s practices to changing technology, needs or social expectations while keeping the underlying purpose.
aliasCandidateFindings.ownerGrammar: Move with the times is an intransitive verb phrase; the subject is usually an organisation or person adapting over time. Move changes tense; with the times stays fixed.
aliasCandidateFindings.rationale: Evolve with the times and move with the times share adaptation outcome, but the former is a productive verb variant; owner’s fixed target and assessments teach move.
aliasCandidateFindings.requiredOwnerAndDecisionWork: Verify variant is a useful taught unit; if so add bounded evolve with the times form and one assessment of adaptation without duplicating owner.
